description:
TuneWorks connects ChatGPT to your performance vehicle workspace, giving you access to the build history, setup data, sessions, maintenance, ECU logs, and other information behind each vehicle.

Analyze performance data, compare setup revisions, review driving sessions, diagnose problems, track maintenance, manage shop and event preparation, and use the history of a build to understand what changed and decide what to test next. TuneWorks keeps logs, setups, sessions, charts, notes, and vehicle information connected so decisions are based on the full context of the build.

TuneWorks supports both read and write actions, allowing you to retrieve information and take action directly from ChatGPT. You can also collaborate around shared vehicles and builds, maintain an ongoing performance history, and share selected build information with tuners, teammates, shops, or crew.

defaultPrompt: Diagnose why my car is understeering mid-corner and recommend setup changes.
Analyze my tire temperatures and suggest tire pressure or alignment adjustments.
Help me choose suspension, tire, and alignment changes for my next track session.
